description: Elections Commission - Declare that M. M. M. Thaiyar as a member of the Akkaraipattu Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
